solutions.title: Layer four-way swaps
solutions.strategy: Rotate each square layer by moving four corresponding edge cells at a time.

timeComplexity.explanation: Every cell participates in a constant number of swaps.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only temporary scalar storage is used for each four-way swap.

solutions.title: Transpose then reverse rows
solutions.strategy: Transpose the matrix across its main diagonal, then reverse each row to complete a clockwise rotation.

timeComplexity.explanation: The transpose and row reversals each touch O(n^2) cells.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The swaps use only temporary scalar storage.
